item.title: Remembering Robert Duvall
item.description: Miami, FL - February 16, 2026 - Robert Duvall, the Oscar-winning actor best known for his indelible performances in The Godfather, Apocalypse Now and Tender Mercies, has died at 95. Born in San Diego and trained under famed acting coach Sanford Meisner, Duvall built a résumé that stretched from stage to screen, earning seven Academy Award nominations and winning Best Actor for his portrayal of a broken country singer in Tender Mercies.
